main.description: Tombstone for a logical record that has been rekeyed or 'deleted'. AT Protocol MST is append-only — a tombstone is the only operationally meaningful 'delete' on the substrate. It binds the prior envelope CID to either (a) a successor envelope CID (rekey), (b) a 'redacted' marker (logical delete; no successor), or (c) a 'sealed' marker (key destroyed; ciphertext intentionally orphaned). Per ADR-2605231603.

supersededCid.description: CID of the previous com.etzhayyim.encrypted.record envelope being tombstoned

supersededKeyId.description: keyId of the previous envelope (matches keyWrap.keyId)

supersededAtUri.description: AT URI of the previous envelope record

tombstoneType.description: rekey: a successor envelope with a fresh sym_key exists. redact: logical delete, no successor. sealed: key intentionally destroyed (e.g. revocation of all key-wraps + sender forgets the sym_key).

successorCid.description: CID of the successor envelope (REQUIRED when tombstoneType='rekey')

scope.description: single-record tombstones one envelope. channel-window tombstones every envelope written by `actorDid` in the inclusive time window [windowStart, windowEnd]. group-rekey tombstones every envelope whose recipient set included the removed member.

actorDid.description: DID issuing the tombstone — MUST be the original sender for rekey/sealed, or a charter-authorized actor (e.g. Council) for regulator-order

auditWebhookDids.description: DIDs that should receive an com.etzhayyim.audit.event for this tombstone
